description: Verbatim official priority-review and accelerated-approval drug lists from FDA CDER's annual 'New Drug Therapy Approvals' reports, captured live through the page-fetch tool on 2026-09-18 (UTC) for the v10 pathway reconciliation. These lists are the FDA's own published determination of which novel drugs were designated priority review; both reports explicitly exclude priority-review-voucher redemptions. Each list below is transcribed exactly as printed in the report PDF (semicolon-separated names).

2024.report_title: Advancing Health Through Innovation: New Drug Therapy Approvals 2024
2024.priority_review_list_verbatim: Alhemo, Aqneursa, Bizengri, Crenessity, Duvyzat, Exblifep, Imdelltra, Iqirvo, Itovebi, Kisunla, Lazcluze, Livdelzi, Lumisight, Miplyffa, Nemluvio, Niktimvo, Ojemda, Orlynvah, Revuforj, Rezdiffra, Tryngolza, Voranigo, Vyloy, Winrevair, Xolremdi, Yorvipath, Zevtera, Ziihera
2024.priority_review_intro_verbatim: In 2024, 28 of the 50 novel drugs approved (56%) were designated priority review.
2024.voucher_exclusion_verbatim: (In some instances, sponsors may redeem a priority review voucher under CDER's priority review voucher program. Such drugs are not included in the list below, and do not meet priority review criteria.)
2024.accelerated_approval_list_verbatim: Bizengri, Imdelltra, Iqirvo, Livdelzi, Ojemda, Rezdiffra, Ziihera
2024.appendix_a_note: Appendix A (CDER's Novel Approvals of 2024) carries columns Approval Date / Proprietary Name / Active Ingredient(s) / FDA-approved use / Dosage Form - no review-classification column (verified in the same capture).

2025.report_title: Advancing Health Through Innovation: New Drug Therapy Approvals 2025
2025.priority_review_list_verbatim: Avmapki Fakzynja; Blujepa; Brinsupri; Emrelis; Forzinity; Gomekli; Hernexeos; Hyrnuo; Ibtrozi; Imaavy; Jascayd; Journavx; Komzifti; Kygevvi; Lynozyfic; Modeyso; Nuzolvence; Romvimza; Voyxact; Yartemlea; Zegfrovy
2025.priority_review_intro_verbatim: In 2025, 21 of the 46 novel drugs approved (46%) were designated priority review.
2025.voucher_exclusion_verbatim: (Priority review for new drugs and biologics may be granted in other circumstances, such as when sponsors redeem a priority review voucher under CDER's priority review voucher program. Such drugs are not included in the list below, and do not meet priority review criteria.)
2025.accelerated_approval_list_verbatim: Avmapki Fakzynja; Emrelis; Forzinity; Hernexeos; Hyrnuo; Keytruda Qlex; Lynozyfic; Modeyso; Vanrafia; Voyxact; Zegfrovy
